entries.name: Frostbitten Sledge

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (atom.ferocity, low, atk Increased) plus the inherited base stat is the only stat-sheet contribution; atom.freezing is status.apply, not a raw stat, so it does not count toward the ceiling. Comfortably under the 60% baseline a grafted-rung rolled rare carries.

entries.flavor: It swings on the half-beat, same as everyone else in the column.
entries.notes: control axis, armament-primary (main-hand), row 1 of the eight allocated to this partition. baseType item.humanoid-main-hand-b-003 (Lumbering Sledge) resolves in humanoid-armament-primary-b.json; role armament-primary is on the AllowedRoles list and is not jewel-minor. Core is 2 fixed atoms + 1 variance slot (3 total, under the 4-atom cap including the inherited base stat). Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard']('frostbitten') + nounPools['armament-primary.humanoid']('sledge'), a pattern base types never draw from (base types are barred from theme pools). Tagged 'signature' as this partition's one flagship entry (notability axis, tags.v1.json) - a curation flag, not a power claim. Not a set member: sets/frostbitten-vanguard.json's armament-primary members (Stillmarch, Winterhold) name a role only, never a pinned baseType, so no collision is possible.

entries.name: Stiffened Harness

counterPressure.note: atom.fortitude (low, maxHp Increased) is the only raw-stat line; atom.cleansing is status.clear, not a raw stat. One low-band line stays well inside the 60% ceiling against a cultivated-rung rolled baseline of 2-3 affixes.

entries.flavor: The straps never loosened. Neither did anything else.
entries.notes: utility axis, core-guard (torso), row 2. baseType item.humanoid-torso-b-006 (Ponderous Cage) resolves in humanoid-core-guard-b.json. Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard']('stiffened') + nounPools['core-guard.humanoid']('harness'); the noun pool is drawn independently of the specific baseType chosen, per poolAccess.uniquePartition ('any nounPools entry'). Core is 2 fixed atoms + 1 variance slot. Sets claim core-guard by role only (Stillmarch, Icebound) - no pinned baseType to collide with.

entries.name: Arrested Yoke

counterPressure.note: atom.ward-harden (low, combat.crit.resist Increased) is the sole raw-stat line; atom.midas is resource.economy, not a combat raw stat, so its generosity is free per the same device the exemplar uses. Under the 60% ceiling.

entries.flavor: Meant to carry the load forward. It carries it in place.
entries.notes: economy axis, ward-array (shoulders), row 3 - the one role of the eight that no set in sets/frostbitten-vanguard.json claims at all. baseType item.humanoid-shoulders-b-007 (Soldered Girder) resolves in humanoid-ward-array-b.json. atom.midas's own roles list (girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor) does not include ward-array, which is legal here per ssot-uniques.md §3.5 rung 2: fixed atoms sit outside the drawn pool, so no affix_pool_tag filters them. Name is themeAdjectivePools('arrested') + nounPools['ward-array.humanoid']('yoke') - a yoke also reads as logistics/burden-bearing, which is the economy-axis tie-in.

entries.name: Frozen Torc

counterPressure.note: atom.keen-edge (low, combat.crit.rate Flat) is the only raw-stat line; atom.searing-strike is resource.delta (OnDamageDealt), not a raw stat, so it can be generous per the exemplar's own device. Under the 60% ceiling for a cultivated rung.

entries.flavor: Command passed through it once. It has not passed since.
entries.notes: offense axis, jewel-major (neck), row 4. baseType item.humanoid-neck-b-004 (Substantial Collar) resolves in humanoid-jewel-major-b.json. element 'ice' is themes.v1.json's sole elementAffinity for frostbitten-vanguard and one of the six concrete elements in core.v1.json - resolves the atom.searing-strike '{variant}' placeholder, the only field a fixedAtoms entry needs to supply for a variant family. Name is themeAdjectivePools('frozen') + nounPools['jewel-major.humanoid']('torc'); 'torc' is also a class-ladder adjective-pool key (jewel.humanoid.torc) but here it is used as the NOUN from nounPools['jewel-major.humanoid'], a distinct pool.

entries.name: Numbed Visor

counterPressure.note: atom.fortitude (low, maxHp Increased) is the only raw-stat line; atom.warded is shield.grant (OnSpawn), not a raw stat. Under the 60% ceiling against a grafted-rung rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: Nothing gets in past the ice. Nothing gets out either.
entries.notes: survivability axis, sense (face), row 5. baseType item.humanoid-face-b-008 (Corrugated Face) resolves in humanoid-sense-b.json. element 'ice' fills atom.warded's variant placeholder, matching the theme's sole elementAffinity - the same family/params pairing sets/frostbitten-vanguard.json's Coldstride threshold already uses on a different container. Name is themeAdjectivePools('numbed') + nounPools['sense.humanoid']('visor').

entries.name: Brittle Tread

counterPressure.note: atom.fortitude (low, maxHp Increased) is the only raw-stat line; atom.entangling is status.apply, not a raw stat. Under the 60% ceiling for a cultivated rung.

entries.flavor: One more step and it would have shattered. It never took the step.
entries.notes: control axis, footing (feet), row 6. baseType item.humanoid-feet-b-011 (Galvanised Tread) resolves in base-types/footing/humanoid/b.json. Distinct role/axis pair from row 1 (armament-primary/control), so no UniqueAxisCollision at this rung band. Name is themeAdjectivePools('brittle') + nounPools['footing.humanoid']('tread'); a different adjective from 'unique.umbral-swarm-50-006' Massed Tread (a different rung band's own partition), so no name collision.

entries.name: Torpid Canteen

counterPressure.note: atom.fortitude (low, maxHp Increased) is the only raw-stat line; atom.sust-freshgraft is status.clear (OnSpawn), not a raw stat. Under the 60% ceiling against a grafted-rung rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: Whatever is inside stopped moving before the marching did.
entries.notes: utility axis, infusion (bandolier), row 7. baseType item.humanoid-bandolier-b-012 (Leaden Cooler) resolves in base-types-infusion-humanoid-b.json. Name is themeAdjectivePools('torpid') + nounPools['infusion.humanoid']('canteen').

entries.name: Horn of Muster

counterPressure.note: atom.ferocity (low, atk Increased) is the only raw-stat line; atom.econ-muster is resource.economy, not a raw stat. Under the 60% ceiling for a cultivated rung.

entries.flavor: It calls the roll. Fewer answer every winter.
entries.notes: economy axis, retinue (horn), row 8 of 8 - the last of the eight roles allocated to this partition (UniqueRuleCheck.AllowedRoles). baseType item.humanoid-horn-a-004 (Dinged Bell) resolves in base-types/retinue/humanoid/a.json. Name uses the <Base> of <Concept> pattern: nounPools['retinue.humanoid']('horn') + conceptPools['frostbitten-vanguard']('muster') - atom.econ-muster's own family id happens to share the word, which is the intentional tie-in, not a coincidence to flag.
